sloka: को माम् सम्ध्याम् उपास्य एव स्नात्वा हुत हुत अशनः ।श्लाघयिष्यति उपासीनः पुत्र शोक भय अर्दितम् ॥२-६४-३४॥
transliteration: ko mām samdhyām upāsya eva snātvā huta huta aśanaḥ ।ślāghayiṣyati upāsīnaḥ putra śoka bhaya arditam ॥2-64-34॥

translations.english: 'O son I am tortured with sorrow and fear. Who will serve me from now on after the ablution and the morning worship of Sandhya, followed by oblations to the sacrificial fire?
